goal: Iske baad aap menu-driven project ko standard tarteeb mein laga sakenge: includes, struct, constants, prototypes, main menu loop ke saath, phir function definitions, file load aur save ke saath.
warmup: Achhe canteen menu board ki ek tarteeb hoti hai: pehle heading, phir items, phir prices. Agar prices pehle aa jayen to koi samajh na paye. Program file bhi aisi hi hai. Jab sab ek hi tarteeb use karte hain, to cheezein jaldi mil jati hain aur aap ka teacher aap ka code chand minutes mein parh leta hai.
definition: Program skeleton ek tayyar layout hai jise aap bharte hain. Menu-driven project ke liye recommended layout yeh hai: (1) #include lines, (2) ek record ke liye struct, (3) constants jaise MAX, (4) function prototypes, (5) main jis mein array, counter aur menu loop ho, (6) main ke baad likhi function definitions. Prototype ek line ka wada hai: yeh compiler ko function ka naam aur parameters bata deta hai taake main use call kar sake, us se pehle ke uska poora code nazar aaye.
howItWorks: Poora sample dekhein. main chhota hai: yeh records ka array banata hai, counter n jo batata hai kitne records istemal mein hain, file se purana data load karta hai, aur phir do-while loop chalata hai. Loop ke andar yeh menu print karta hai, choice parhta hai aur switch use karta hai. Har case EK function call karta hai. Loop tab ruk jata hai jab user Save and Exit chunta hai. Asal kaam sab main ke baad ke functions mein hai. addRecord array aur counter n ko reference (int &n) se leta hai kyunke use count barhana hai. showAll aur searchRecord sirf parhte hain, is liye unka array const hai. saveToFile pehle count likhta hai aur phir har record text file mein. loadFromFile shuru mein use wapas parhta hai, aur agar file abhi maujood na ho to kuch nahi karta. Structure ki aam galtiyan: function ko likhna jab uska prototype maloom na ho, sab kuch main mein likh dena, case mein break bhool jana, n ko MAX se check karna bhool jana, aur n ko reference se pass karna bhool jana jis se count kabhi nahi badalta.
